h1_2026_growth.formula_note: Current H1 divided by prior-year H1 minus one.

owner_cash_proxy.definition: Operating cash flow minus PPE purchases minus stock-based compensation expense. This treats SBC as an economic cash-equivalent cost and is not GAAP free cash flow.
limitations: Working-capital timing remains material; H1 2026 contract liabilities added cash while accounts receivable consumed cash.
This proxy is not incremental ROIC and does not establish distributable cash.
Interest income and gains on marketable securities are not treated as recurring operating economics in the forward owner-margin model.

sbc_and_dilution.note: Absolute SBC increased despite improving SBC/revenue. Outstanding options, RSUs and SARs remain an economic dilution overhang.

market_reference.note: Valuation multiples are calculations from a secondary reference quote and filing share/liquidity data, not provider-reported market capitalization.
